licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (quà, po without its apostrophe, bell' occhio as two words).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 122–124, bars 1–68 of No. 15
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung line and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is a one-eighth upbeat, set as 1/8. Kept as printed, where repeats differ: the left hand's third eighth in bars 20 and 24 (F sharp, then A) and the voice's second note in bars 33 and 53 (F sharp, then D). Playback tempo: Andantino, played at ♩ = 88, about 1½ minutes, the median of seven recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis, Gardiner, Marriner); Mozart gives the word only.
